alignments.note: Privative adjective rendered without + noun; the noun glosses the stem and takes the head (rule 84).

Privative compound rendered covenant breakers: covenant glosses the synthet- stem and breakers spells the privative, so the head follows rule 84's reasoning and stands on covenant. Heading on breakers remains defensible. Variant SBLGNT.ROM.1.31.v009 selects r00-base, which the ASV translates.
Privative adjective rendered without natural affection, headed on the noun glossing the storg- stem (rule 84).

review_notes: s002's head is the one genuinely contested choice in this verse and its note names the competing reading.
